name: tt-moeoffload
description: An inference engine that uses 1x p150a + host CPU and RAM to run large MoE models, in the spirit of [Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/tree/main)-lineage projects. Currently supports limited quantizations of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash.
author: simbilod
